from pathlib import Path

orders = [
    ("ORD-5B048F", "2026-09-02", "Confirmed", 108),
    ("ORD-542FDA", "2026-09-02", "Confirmed", 68),
    ("ORD-6C71B1", "2026-09-02", "Cancelled", 55),
    ("ORD-12AAA3", "2026-09-02", "Cancelled", 42),
]

confirmed = [
    order
    for order in orders
    if order[1] == "2026-09-02"
    and order[2].strip().casefold() == "confirmed"
]

lines = ["Order ID | Order Date | Status | Quantity"]
lines.extend(
    f"{order_id} | {order_date} | {status} | {quantity}"
    for order_id, order_date, status, quantity in confirmed
)

output_path = Path("confirmed_orders_2026-09-02.txt")
output_path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

print(f"Created {output_path} with {len(confirmed)} confirmed orders.")
